extras: Unofficial fan project; requires user to bring their own game content.
intentEvidence: Statblocks and character sheets for the Dungeon Crawler Carl roleplaying game, rendered right inside your Obsidian notes.
problem: It addresses the need for a structured way to manage and render complex TTRPG character sheets, stat blocks, and combat encounters within Obsidian notes.
summary: Provides statblocks, character sheets, skills, spells, and a play widget for running the Dungeon Crawler Carl RPG inside Obsidian notes.
